mechanism.claim: Continuation versus reversal after a volatile BTC block depends on the ordering frequencies of consecutive price triples and the transition structure of minute-return signs; one fixed pre-2023 linear classifier estimates the next-eight-hour sign.
mechanism.side: strict sign of frozen classification score
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOCPR uses ordinal-pattern and sign-transition distributions, not directional-change counts, rank concordance, Fourier energy, path analog distances, OI/premium state, or any prior event/control outcome.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: ordinal dynamics on fixed eight-hour boundaries are absent from Gross9

training_contract.label: strict sign of log(exit_open/entry_open), entry=D+5m, exit=entry+8h, exit strictly before label end; zero label rejected
training_contract.standardization: population mean/std on training rows only; reject nonfinite/zero scale
training_contract.estimator: closed-form standardized ridge classifier with intercept alpha=100 and targets {-1,+1}
training_contract.score_threshold: numpy linear-method q50 of absolute fitted scores among training rows variation_rank>=0.65; OOS uses >=

feature_contract.returns: 479 close-to-close log returns; root variation=sqrt(sum squares)
feature_contract.ordinal_patterns: for each of 478 consecutive log-close triples with three distinct values, stable ascending-rank permutation among 012,021,102,120,201,210; each count divided by valid distinct triples; reject if none
feature_contract.sign_transitions: for each of 478 adjacent return pairs with both strict nonzero, frequencies pp,pn,np,nn divided by valid pairs; reject if none
feature_contract.normalized_returns: full and final-two-hour returns divided by root variation
feature_contract.absolute_return_autocorrelation: absolute Pearson correlation of adjacent absolute returns with nonzero variances
feature_contract.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank <=270 valid blocks, minimum180, current excluded

oos_clock.eligibility: source valid, variation_rank>=0.65, frozen score finite/nonzero, abs score>=frozen q50
oos_clock.reservation: fixed boundaries half-open; exit first on equal open
oos_clock.funding: not input; exact only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp sides, favorable-then-adverse held 5m, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: new ordinal-dynamics classification mechanism specified before its labels/incidence

stopping_rule: freeze prereg/model/source/novelty/economics; terminal first failure; no feature/alpha/threshold/side/hold/clock/subset/control repair
